{{AnimePokémonInfobox |type1=Bug |type2=Poison |trainername=Goh |pokemonname=Beedrill |jtrainername=ゴウ |jpokemonname=スピアー |tmtrainername=Go |tmpokemonname=Spear |image=[[File:Goh Beedrill.png|250px]] |caption=Goh's Beedrill |prevonum=015 |epnum=JN006 |epname=Working My Way Back to Mew! |location=[[Vermilion Forest]] |current=[[Cerise Laboratory|Cerise Park]] |gender=Unknown |ability=Unknown |noevo=incap |java1=[[Risa Shimizu]] |enva1= }} '''Goh's Beedrill''' (Japanese: '''ゴウのスピアー''' ''Go's Spear'') is the tenth {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that [[Goh]] {{pkmn2|caught}} in the [[Kanto]] [[region]], and his eleventh overall. ==In animation== ===History=== ===={{aniseries|JN}}==== [[File:Goh and Beedrill.png|thumb|left|250px|Beedrill and Goh]] In ''[[JN006|Working My Way Back to Mew!]]'', {{p|Beedrill}} was part of a swarm in [[Vermilion Forest]] that attacked Goh when he caught a {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Weedle and Kakuna|Kakuna}}. When most of the swarm was trapped by {{AP|Pikachu}}'s {{m|Electroweb}}, Goh caught the lone Beedrill that wasn't hit, assuming it was the strongest. After that, Goh kept it at the [[Cerise Laboratory]]. In ''[[JN014|Raid Battle in The Ruins!]]'', Goh used Beedrill to cross the [[Desert Resort]]. As they traversed, it got into a race with [[Ash's Dragonite]]. Later, it was used in a [[Raid Battle (GO)#In animation|Raid Battle]] against a {{TP|Goh|Golurk}}, but it was easily defeated. In ''[[JN015|A Snow Day for Searching!]]'', Goh used Beedrill, {{TP|Goh|Scorbunny}}, {{TP|Goh|Scyther}}, and several others to find a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{TP|Goh|Cubone}}'s lost bone. In ''[[JN023|Panic in the Park!]]'', Beedrill was the first of Goh's Pokémon to discover its food had been stolen, which made it extremely agitated, leading to frustration when {{Ash}} didn't understand why it was upset. Beedrill later assembled a group made up of Goh's other {{type|Bug}} Pokémon, which came into conflict with another faction led by [[Goh's Darmanitan]]. As the battle escalated, {{TP|Goh|Scyther}} took control of the Bug-type group, but the infighting ended when Golurk lost control of itself, causing [[Cerise Laboratory|Cerise Park]] to become flooded. Beedrill joined the rest of the Pokémon in saving Goh's three {{p|Cascoon}}, allowing them to [[Evolution|evolve]] into {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Dustox}} and clear the storm with {{m|Sunny Day}}. In ''[[JN107|Big Brother to the Rescue!]]'', Goh used Beedrill, along with other Pokémon in the park, to create a fountain so that {{TP|Goh|Grimer}} and {{TP|Goh|Froakie}} could live in Cerise Laboratory without dirtying the stream. In ''[[JN136|This Could be the Start of Something Big!]]'', Beedrill attended a surprise party hosted by the Lab members commemorating Goh and Ash's departure. {{-}} ===Personality and characteristics=== [[File:Ash Dragonite Goh Beedrill.png|left|thumb|250px|Beedrill and {{AP|Dragonite}}]] [[File:Goh Beedrill hostility.png|thumb|250px|Beedrill attacking [[Goh]] and {{Ash}}]] Beedrill is extremely aggressive, even attacking its own Trainer and others. It is also very competitive, even sparking a brief rivalry with [[Ash's Dragonite]] as it and its Trainer crossed the [[Desert Resort]]. This rivalry is briefly seen again in ''[[JN095|The Good, The Bad, and The Lucky!]]'', where Goh and Ash were in a new dispute with Beedrill and Dragonite crossing a desert again. As of ''[[JN015|A Snow Day for Searching!]]'', Beedrill appears to be fully involved with the rest of Goh's [[Party|team]] and more obedient to its Trainer's commands. When Goh's party found {{TP|Goh|Cubone}}'s missing bone, and also when they were introduced to its Trainer's family, Beedrill proudly presented itself as one of Goh's Pokémon. {{-}} ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|bug|poison|Goh Beedrill {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Twineedle|1=Aerial Ace}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Twineedle|1=Aerial Ace}}}} {{anmov|bug|Twineedle|JN014|Raid Battle in The Ruins!}} {{anmov|flying|Aerial Ace|JN030|Betrayed, Bothered, and Beleaguered!}} {{anmov/f|poison}} ===Artwork=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{flying color dark}}; background: #{{bug color}}; font-size:80%;" |- | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{flying color dark}}; background: #{{flying color light}}"| [[File:JN006 illustration.png|x250px]] |- | Official artwork of
